answer: Duplicate identities collapse when entry costs a bonded, externally measured compute trace: each newcomer stakes POA behind a signed job whose runtime fingerprint peers replay before vouching. A falcon on the audit side is the cluster sweep, flagging two accounts that post traces sharing a rare hardware signature, and both bonds burn. Honest labour leaves an opal shimmer of varied timings across a dune of machines, a pattern no scripted farm reproduces cheaply.
